items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had a business downtown, Mandel and Shaft…

ctx.x: What did your father do for a living?

He was a cloak-and-suiter. He had a business downtown, Mandel and Shaft… And the depression and the new deal combined to force him out kind of. The NRA [National Recovery Administration] in specifically, although he remained a Roosevelt Democrat right up till his death in 1937. And he finally just said, well, he was a pretty successful cloak-and-suiter but he just couldn’t, he just didn’t want to do it anymore after.
